tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.braised_ch: You will not discard the bones before savoring them three times.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.cold_houtt: One bite and the houttuynia slaps your soul awake.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.dark_grill: Oh, it tastes so good! Yuck.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.green_pepp: Flash-fried before the squid tentacles had time to think.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.grilled_be: Charred outside and juicy inside: two personalities on one skewer.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.grilled_bu: Soft white steamed bread finds a whole new life over charcoal.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.grilled_ca: Crunchy protein, with an equally crunchy test of courage.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.grilled_en: Do not trust the outside. This one is all about the burst.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.grilled_fi: Cooked just right, with smoke and char down to the bones.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.grilled_fr: The fried egg returns for its second debut.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.grilled_gl: Crisp outside, chewy within, and more fragrant with every bite.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.grilled_go: A skewer so radiant that even death has to wait ten seconds.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.grilled_la: The charcoal brings every trace of lamb fat and aroma to the surface.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.grilled_me: Tender meat and crisp bone belong in the same bite.
Three meatballs in a row, reborn over the fire.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.grilled_mi: Golden on both sides and flavorful after four turns.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.grilled_mu: Full of smoke and fire, too impatient to wait for the clay pot.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.grilled_po: Fat and lean together, grilled until the oil starts singing.
Crisp at the edges, soft in the middle. Potatoes understand charcoal.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.grilled_sq: The charcoal curled up the taste of the sea. A swim sounds good now.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.grilled_sw: Soft, crisp-edged, and carrying the unmistakable attitude of houttuynia.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.houttuynia: Some hate its bite, others love it with rice. Houttuynia does not care.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.mysterious: What is that, and what exactly was being grilled?
tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.ordinary_s: Try it and you may die trying.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.pepper_hon: Eating this... how is it different from chewing an electric wire?
tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.potato_bee: Potatoes soaked in gravy and beef tender enough to need no teeth.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.red_sweet_: Very filling, but not very nutritious. Better take it easy.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.roasted_ch: It cooks without a skewer, but misses the bustle beside the coals.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.roasted_sw: Warm your hands first; winter begins properly after the first bite.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.sour_spicy: Sour enough to wake you, hot enough to make you sweat, and impossible to stop slurping.
tooltip.kaleidoscope_grilling.sugared_to: Sweet, tart, and ready to close out a barbecue.
